How we built code review for agents

Code review has always been the place where a team agrees on what good looks like. When agents started opening pull requests, that agreement had to be written down in a form a model could follow.

We started with the review comments engineers already leave every day, grouped them by intent, and turned the most common groups into checks that run before a human ever opens the diff.

The result is not a replacement for a reviewer. It is a first pass that catches the mechanical issues, so the people on the team can spend their attention on design and intent.
